avoid_supplements.name: Chromium picolinate
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May enhance insulin sensitivity and reduce blood glucose, increasing hypoglycemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before supplementation

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (American or Asian)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Reduces blood glucose levels and may potentiate insulin effect, increasing hypoglycemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue use or monitor blood glucose closely with frequent testing

avoid_supplements.name: Fenugreek seeds
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Lowers postprandial and fasting glucose; enhances insulin action
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; consult healthcare provider regarding diabetes management

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-lipoic acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: May improve insulin sensitivity in some patients; modest glucose-lowering effect
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; dose adjustment of insulin may be needed

caution_supplements.name: Bitter melon
caution_supplements.mechanism: Has mild glucose-lowering properties that may additively reduce blood glucose
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose regularly; inform prescriber of use

avoid_foods.name: Excessive refined carbohydrates and simple sugars
avoid_foods.mechanism: Causes rapid blood glucose spikes that may overwhelm insulin detemir's steady-state action, leading to glycemic variability
avoid_foods.action: Maintain consistent carbohydrate intake; choose complex carbohydrates and low glycemic index foods

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Delays gastric emptying and carbohydrate absorption, potentially prolonging postprandial glucose elevation
caution_foods.action: Monitor postprandial glucose; coordinate meal timing with insulin administration

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (especially on empty stomach)
caution_foods.mechanism: Impairs hepatic glucose production and increases hypoglycemia risk, particularly with basal insulins
caution_foods.action: Consume moderate amounts with food; monitor blood glucose; educate on hypoglycemia awareness

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood glucose regularly, especially when initiating or changing supplements/diet. Insulin detemir is minimally metabolized hepatically, reducing drug-drug interactions, but hypoglycemia risk increases with concurrent glucose-lowering agents or supplements.
